synthesize.question: Summarize AMD’s primary product categories described in the Business section.
synthesize.golden_answer: Server CPUs, GPUs, DPUs, FPGAs and Adaptive SoCs for data centers; CPUs, APUs and chipsets for PCs; discrete GPUs, semi-custom SoCs and development services; and embedded CPUs, GPUs, APUs, FPGAs and Adaptive SoCs

synthesize.question: Which major customer types does AMD say it sells to across its microprocessor and graphics businesses?
synthesize.golden_answer: OEMs, cloud providers, ODMs, system integrators, distributors, retailers, and AIB manufacturers

synthesize.question: List the four reportable business segments AMD uses for financial reporting.
synthesize.golden_answer: Data Center; Client; Gaming; Embedded

synthesize.question: What themes best summarize AMD’s stated corporate strategy?
synthesize.golden_answer: High-performance and adaptive computing technology, software and product leadership, focused on compute technology leadership, expanding data center leadership, enabling pervasive AI, providing software platforms and developer enablement, and designing custom silicon and solutions

synthesize.question: Which end markets are highlighted for AMD’s data center graphics and accelerator products?
synthesize.golden_answer: HPC, AI/ML, cloud gaming, cloud visualization, and enterprise data centers

synthesize.question: Name the major PC processor subcategories AMD describes within its client products.
synthesize.golden_answer: Desktop CPUs, notebook CPUs, and commercial CPUs

synthesize.question: What are the main types of graphics offerings AMD groups under its gaming and data center graphics discussions?
synthesize.golden_answer: Discrete desktop and notebook GPUs, professional GPUs, data center GPUs/accelerators, and visual cloud or cloud gaming/remote visualization GPUs

synthesize.question: What key technology and innovation priorities are emphasized in AMD’s research and development discussion?
synthesize.golden_answer: Next-generation CPUs, GPUs, FPGAs, Adaptive SoCs, accelerators, SOMs and SmartNICs, improved performance and performance-per-watt, advanced process technologies, logic and interface IP, advanced packaging, heterogeneous integration, and enabling software platforms and tools

synthesize.question: Which manufacturing stages does AMD mainly outsource to third parties according to the report?
synthesize.golden_answer: Wafer fabrication, board manufacturing, and assembly/test/mark/packaging

synthesize.question: Summarize the main competitive threats AMD identifies across its Data Center, Client, Gaming, and Embedded segments.
synthesize.golden_answer: Intel, NVIDIA, ARM-based competitors, FPGA and ASIC/ASSP competitors, and competition from integrated and discrete graphics suppliers

synthesize.question: What principal areas of employee focus are described under AMD’s Human Capital section?
synthesize.golden_answer: Mission, culture and engagement; diversity, belonging and inclusion; total rewards; and development

synthesize.question: What major risks tied to supply chain dependence are highlighted in the Risk Factors section?
synthesize.golden_answer: Foundry reliance, capacity shortages, limited suppliers, material constraints, and yield issues

synthesize.question: Which types of products and technologies power AMD’s semi-custom business according to the report?
synthesize.golden_answer: Customer-specific SoCs based on AMD CPU, GPU, and multimedia technologies

synthesize.question: What are the principal operating expense categories in AMD’s consolidated statements of operations?
synthesize.golden_answer: Research and development; marketing, general and administrative; and amortization of acquisition-related intangibles

synthesize.question: What key factors does AMD say determine product competitiveness in its markets?
synthesize.golden_answer: Timely introductions, quality, features, efficiency, reliability, performance, price, integration, compatibility, security, and brand

synthesize.question: What broad categories of legal and regulatory exposure does AMD describe in its risk factors?
synthesize.golden_answer: Export controls, tariffs, taxes, litigation, environmental laws, and conflict minerals rules

synthesize.question: What major financial changes does AMD report for 2022 versus 2021 in the MD&A overview?
synthesize.golden_answer: Higher revenue and cash, lower gross margin, lower operating income and net income, and higher debt

synthesize.question: Which product families are repeatedly emphasized as growth drivers in 2022 across client, server, graphics, and adaptive computing markets?
synthesize.golden_answer: Ryzen, Radeon, Instinct, EPYC, Versal, and Pensando DPUs

synthesize.question: What broad benefits does AMD claim customers receive from an all-AMD platform?
synthesize.golden_answer: Optimized interoperability, single point of contact, and faster time to market

synthesize.question: Summarize the main conditions and economics of AMD’s completed Xilinx acquisition described in the filing.
synthesize.golden_answer: AMD completed the all-stock acquisition of Xilinx on February 14, 2022 for about $48.8 billion of purchase consideration, issuing about 429 million AMD shares and assuming Xilinx equity awards

multi_hop.question: AMD says customer A accounted for 16% of 2022 revenue, and total 2022 net revenue was $23.601 billion. Approximately how much revenue did that customer represent?
Using the 2022 net revenue and the approximately 25,000 employees reported in Human Capital, what was AMD’s approximate revenue per employee in 2022?
AMD reported 2022 net income of $1.320 billion and 1,611,388,217 common shares outstanding as of February 22, 2023. About how much net income per outstanding share does that imply?
The report says AMD leased 5 million square feet and had approximately 25,000 employees. About how many square feet leased per employee does that equal?
AMD reported 2022 cash, cash equivalents and short-term investments of $5.855 billion and total debt principal of $2.501 billion. Approximately how much did liquidity exceed debt by?
Using AMD’s February 22, 2023 outstanding share count of 1,611,388,217, what is 1% of AMD’s outstanding shares, approximately?
AMD reported 2022 U.S. sales of $8.049 billion and said international sales were 66% of net revenue. What approximate dollar amount of 2022 revenue was international?

The filing states AMD had approximately 8,200 U.S. patents and approximately 2,200 U.S. patent applications pending as of December 31, 2022. Compared with approximately 25,000 employees, what is the combined total of those U.S. patent matters per employee, approximately?
AMD’s 2022 market value of non-affiliate stock was about $139.8 billion based on a June 24, 2022 closing price of $87.08. Approximately how many non-affiliate shares does that imply?

Using the 2022 operating income of $1.264 billion and the total $12.0 billion repurchase authorization in place after the additional program approved in February 2022, what percentage of the authorization would one year of operating income cover, approximately?
The report gives 2022 basic weighted-average shares of 1,561 million and year-end treasury stock of 33 million shares held. What is the difference between those figures, in millions of shares?
AMD reported $450 million of property and equipment purchases in 2022 and leased 5 million square feet. About how much capital spending per leased square foot does that represent?

The report lists Santa Clara headquarters and says AMD had significant operations in Austin, San Jose, Shanghai, Markham, Longmont, Dublin, Singapore, and Bangalore and Hyderabad. Counting headquarters plus those significant operations, how many major locations are explicitly highlighted?
AMD had about 19,800 patent matters worldwide and approximately 25,000 employees. Roughly how many employees were there per patent matter?
The report states AMD repurchased 36,326,137 shares in 2022 and had 1,612 million shares outstanding at year-end. What percentage of year-end shares did those repurchases represent, approximately?

AMD says its 2022 gross profit was $10.603 billion and that Customer A represented 16% of revenue. Approximately how much gross profit would correspond to that same share of gross profit if margins were uniform?

The filing says the Xilinx acquisition had total purchase consideration of $48.793 billion and AMD’s 2022 net revenue was $23.601 billion. Approximately how many times 2022 revenue was the purchase consideration?
AMD’s report lists three Sunnyvale Superfund sites and approximately $3.9 million in estimated environmental liability. What is the approximate liability per site?
Given AMD’s total current assets of $15.019 billion and total current liabilities of $6.369 billion at December 31, 2022, what was working capital?
AMD reported 2022 basic EPS of $0.85 and a February 22, 2023 closing stock price of $76.61. What approximate price-to-earnings ratio does that imply using basic EPS?
